BiblicalUsage: Jishmerai is an Israelite, a son of Elpaal of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles 8:18, Ishmerai also, and Jezliah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ishmerai shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
